name: A late carer who doesn't turn up, with no cover
description: Thursday's late CA (Lucy) doesn't come and nobody covers: Kasia is the only carer from 19:30. She reserves Dennis's two-person turn, which nobody can partner, and the reservation keeps her off Peggy's toilet request for 95 minutes; she gets no break; Raj's bedtime hoist and Dennis's turn wait with nobody sent for; overnight nobody owns Dennis's missed evening turn and he goes about 6.5 hours unturned.
